description: Source code for board initialization and hardware control in U-Boot bootloader for ox820 platform, including memory testing, UART, DDR, NAND, Ethernet, and system setup functions.

methods.name: test_memory
methods.description: Memory test function that writes and verifies patterns in memory to check for errors.

methods.name: uart_init
methods.description: Initializes UART1 by resetting and setting pin multiplexing.

methods.name: board_inithw
methods.description: Performs hardware initialization including timer, UART, DDR, and optional memory test.

methods.name: board_init_f
methods.description: Sets up stack pointer, clears BSS, initializes global data, and calls hardware init functions.

methods.name: spl_start_uboot
methods.description: Determines whether to break into full U-Boot based on serial input.

methods.name: nand_hwcontrol
methods.description: Controls NAND commands and address lines.

methods.name: nand_dev_ready
methods.description: Checks if NAND device is ready (used in NAND support).

methods.name: nand_read_buf
methods.description: Reads data buffer from NAND device.

methods.name: board_nand_init
methods.description: Initializes NAND hardware interface and static bus.

methods.name: dram_size
methods.description: Detects size of available RAM by testing memory range.
